<thought>Based on the 1H NMR showing a single aromatic multiplet integrating to 10 H, the structure is consistent with diphenylmethane, where two equivalent phenyl rings are attached to a CH₂ group, giving one set of aromatic protons. The SMILES for diphenylmethane is C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2.</thought>
<final_answer>C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
